verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order (headline, subcopy, CTA, fine print), but the left column is spread out with big uneven gaps, nothing is scaled up for the larger square, and the book has slipped off its circle so it hangs over the circle's top edge instead of sitting inside it. B puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks the hierarchy and reading order, and the top is jammed together. The book is also pulled out of its circle and sits off-centre, and the bottom third is empty, so B is lopsided.
